attributeRelationships.help: Declare how this dimension's key column maps to a detail column so the platform can serve queries from a coarser aggregate. Each relationship must be proven against the data on deploy before it accelerates anything.
attributeRelationships.none: No relationships declared for this dimension.
attributeRelationships.needsPhysicalKey: Attribute relationships require a dimension backed by a physical key column. This dimension has none.
attributeRelationships.cardinalityHelp.B: Each key maps to exactly one detail and each detail back to exactly one key — an exact relabel. Both are proven on deploy.
attributeRelationships.cardinalityHelp.F: Many keys may share one detail value (a real coarsening). Only the forward key-to-detail direction is proven.
attributeRelationships.statusHelp.DECLAR: Declared but not yet proven. It will be checked against the data on the next deploy and does not accelerate queries until proven.
attributeRelationships.statusHelp.PENDIN: Checked 1:1 against the source data, but this is a text label whose final certification depends on how the serving table sorts and compares text (its collation). That can only be confirmed once the matching aggregate is built, so it is certified automatically at that point and then becomes Proven. Until then it does not accelerate queries. This is normal and not an error.
attributeRelationships.statusHelp.VERIFI: Proven against the complete data on deploy. This relationship can accelerate matching queries.
attributeRelationships.statusHelp.BROKEN: The data does not satisfy this relationship (a key mapped to more than one detail, or a null endpoint). It will not accelerate queries. Fix the data or change the declaration.
attributeRelationships.statusHelp.STALE: The declaration changed since it was last proven. It will be re-checked on the next deploy.
attributeRelationships.statusHelp.ERROR: The check could not complete (unsupported detail type, timeout, or execution error). It will not accelerate queries.
attributeRelationships.nullPolicyFixed: Null policy: rows with a null key or null detail are excluded from the proof (fixed in this version).
attributeRelationships.createFailed: Failed to declare relationship. The detail column must exist in the dimension's source table and differ from the key, and the same detail and cardinality cannot be declared twice.
